title: GravOp: conditioning-coordinate benchmarks for neural PDE surrogates, with a gravothermal self-interacting dark matter solver and emulator
description: Reference implementation, benchmark generators and acceptance suite for a study of how the conditioning coordinate of a neural operator determines its accuracy when the terminal time it is trained against is unavailable at deployment. The source release contains four reference PDE systems whose evolution ends at a solution-dependent event time (three at a finite-time singularity, one a regular viscous control), a validated gravothermal self-interacting dark matter fluid solver, a Fourier neural operator emulator, a Bayesian inference pipeline, the figure scripts, and the acceptance suite that checks the reported results against the solver, the data and the stored records. The machine-readable results and the rendered figures are deposited in a companion archival record.
